$comment: The registration form of pipelinq's Informatieavond warmtenet Oost (EVT-2026-0012), as PqEvenement's form card draws it: a portal form binding on the Zuiddrecht portal at /warmtenet-oost whose submit creates a pipelinq eventRegistration, and the event's formBinding pointing at it, set from here because a fragment can quote only its own objects and this one runs after pipelinq's. The binding stays a draft: no published form leaf for the event exists yet, and a published binding without one renders an empty form on the public route.

data.confirmationText: Bedankt voor uw aanmelding voor de informatieavond over het warmtenet. U krijgt een bevestiging per e-mail.
